Dear Sir/Madam,  
Subject: Audio recording of earnings conference call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026  
In continuation to our letter dated July 10th, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read 
with clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the Q1 FY27 ended June 
30, 2026 Earnings Conference Call was held today i.e. Wednesday, July 15, 2026 at 4.00 P.M. 
(IST) and audio recording of the same is available on Company's website at following link  
https://www.mbapl.com/financial-and-reports.html#webcast 
Please take the above information on record 
 
Kindly take note of the above.  
Yours faithfully, 
For Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd
